comparison_method: Static input, output, and declared-task-contract comparison against the closest existing toolbox neighbors. No matched real-task outcome, latency, cost, or reliability trial was run.

compared_tools.declared_scope: Summarizes paired candidate outcomes and one caller-declared resource metric into pass-rate, cost, dominated, and frontier results.
compared_tools.difference: It does not bind a frozen predecessor-successor transition, evaluator drift, held-out replay, permission delta, rollback target, or later-round R&D gain.

compared_tools.declared_scope: Checks declared producer and consumer text patterns and field matches from caller-provided source excerpts.
compared_tools.difference: It checks a static producer-consumer relation and does not compare predecessor-successor improvement evidence.

compared_tools.declared_scope: Reviews caller-selected paragraph order and declared cognitive migration while preserving source text boundaries.
compared_tools.difference: Its input and output concern revision structure, not system-transition measurements, evaluator binding, cost, failures, authority, or rollback.

decision.coexistence_basis: Declared inputs and required outputs differ. Static contracts support separate task scopes, but no same-task performance or cost evidence supports ranking, replacement, or retirement.

low_cost_follow_up.proposal: When a multi-successor transition task is available, run one synthetic frozen-transition packet through this preflight and the existing Pareto summary on the same declared outcomes; compare missing-output coverage, operator steps, and local runtime. Keep the contracts separate and all results review-only.

claim_ceiling: The comparison establishes declared contract differences only; it does not establish superior quality, lower cost, reliability, or replacement value.
